USAGE: 

   mx-smi misc  [-hv] [--clear-pcie-event] [--collect-chip-sn] [--detail]
                [--show-board-type] [--show-critical-event]

                <moduleName,loglevel>|--show-fw-loglevel] [-i <deviceId>]
                [--die <dieId>] [--unlock <unlock key>]


Where: 

   -i <deviceId>,  --index <deviceId>
     Target specific devices. The specified id may be the GPU's index in
     the natural enumeration, chip serial number, uuid, or PCI bus ID(as
     domain:bus:device.function in hex). Multiple devices can be combined
     as '0,1,5', '0-2' '0-4,6', 'GPU-2f8ab36b-882a-0248-494e-0da5d8ae9698,
     0000:03:00.0', 'all'

   --die <dieId>
     Target specific die index.

   --show-critical-event
     Display PCIe/MetaXLink critical error event info

   --show-mmio-state
     Display mmio state

   --show-pcie-event
     Display pcie event counter

   --clear-pcie-event
     Clear pcie event counter

   --detail
     Display detailed pcie event info, must be used with --show-pcie-event

   --show-board-type
     Show board type

   --collect-chip-sn
     Collect all chip serial numbers

   --unlock <unlock key>
     Set unlock key (N-class device is not support)

   Either of:
      --show-fw-loglevel
        Display firmware's loglevel

      --set-fw-loglevel <moduleName,loglevel>
        Set firmware's loglevel
            format: <moduleName,<loglevel>; (e.g. "smp0,4")
            moduleName: <all|smp0|smp1|ccx0|ccx1|ccx2|ccx3|xcore|eth>
            loglevel: <5:debug|4:info|3:warn|2:error|1:fatal|0:none>

   --,  --ignore_rest
     Ignores the rest of the labeled arguments following this flag.

   -v,  --version
     Displays version information and exits.

   -h,  --help
     Displays usage information and exits.
